text: こっそり　だれにも　みつからず　れんしゅう　してるんだ！

structure.jp: こっそり　だれにも　みつからず
structure.en: secretly, without being found by anyone

structure.jp: れんしゅう　してるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜ず
patterns.explanation: ず is an older way of saying ない, and in the middle of a sentence it means 'without doing'. みつからず = 'without being found'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on right now. てる is the shortened spoken form. れんしゅう　してる = 'am practicing'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the feeling of explaining yourself. んだ is the spoken form. してるんだ = 'you see, I'm doing it'.
